summary: Round Robin Tournament: A single offline page to run a round-robin tabletop tournament: register players, auto-generate a conflict-free schedule, enter scores, and see live standings — all saved in your browser.
assumptions: Built for A hobbyist who runs small friendly round-robin tournaments and wants to replace paper scoring with a phone-friendly local web app..
Persistence decision: localStorage under a single JSON key 'rrt:state' containing tournament name, date, phase, players[], and matches[]; loaded on app init and written on every mutation

tests_run.journey: Generated journey suite passed: Scheduler generates all unique pairs for 4 and 5 players with no round conflicts; Standings tie-break order: points → difference → scored → alphabetical; Duplicate player name rejected; min-3-players guard prevents scheduling; Score correction updates standings and match state; Malformed localStorage parses to default empty tournament without throwing; Setup form renders tournament name input, date input, and player add field
